Codex.Grabber.description: A rare, valuable Codex. Looks like it may have some currently unknown utility. Think carefully before getting rid of. Codexes are the highest value loot a scav can find. They are extremely rare due to the difficulty in acquiring them from enemies that are extremely difficult or outright impossible to down by normal means. The following bosses each have their own named codex: Rat King Europan Medium Mech (Euruskan Medium Mech shares the same Codex) Grabber* (Stalker shares the same Codex) Toothy Euruskan OrgaMech Euruskan Shield Officer Euruskan Kotleta** Eurasian MotherCourage Eurasian Opal While the Grabber is confirmed to be lootable, it may take several raids, as it sometimes refuses to get stunned after 5+ railgun hits. Its container also spawns far from its body, making it likely to end up out of map bounds. Unlike other Codexes, Kotleta's Codex can spawn on the ground at raid start and triggers unique events when picked up. See Kotleta for more info.

GRL01.description: Grenade Launcher. Uses 40mm HE A semi-automatic Grenade Launcher with a magazine capacity of 6 rounds. Uses 40mm HE. It has nearly unrivaled damage; it is capable of defeating the majority of infantry units, including Europan Hunter Killers in a single direct hit. The Grenade Launcher's damage is partially misleading. The Grenade Launcher deals 1,000 damage on direct impact with its 40mm projectile, however deals an additional 10,000 splash damage. This (presumably) allows the Grenade Launcher to deal up to 11,000 Damage assuming optimal conditions.

HMG01.description: A massive (HMG) that uses Nitro express1. With no sights or lasers usable, over-the-shoulder mode can help a lot with aiming (default left alt key on PC). 1 Nitro express cannot be bought or otherwise obtained in raid. This caps the number of shots the painless can make in a raid.

HRF03.description: Massive (HRF). Uses .50 Cal. Can One Shot Headshot most Foot Soldiers, including Hunter Killers. Can also be used against Exo Skeletons and Tanks, but need a lot of Sucessfull Hits. Pros and Cons compared to other Bolt Action HRF: + Can be found in almost any Raid, drops from certain Europan Sniper Squads - Has pre installed Sniper Scope, cannot change the Reticle

HRF04.description: Kenetic (HRF), Uses .50 Cal. Can One Shot Headshot most Foot Soldiers, including Hunter Killers. Can also be used against Exo Skeletons and Tanks, but need a lot of Sucessfull Hits. Pros and Cons compared to other Bolt Action HRF: + Can Equip Any Regular Scope + Highest Base Accuracy, can be improved with mods to be over 89, making it possible to land guaranteed headshots at LvL 1 Weapon experience - Difficult to get, only possible from Quest Rewards

HRF05.description: A frontline anti-materiel rifle capable of disabling heavy mechs like the Railgun, allowing solo scavs to obtain Codexes. Due to it being classed under Heavy Rifles neither Scav Girl or Shaman can use this weapon.

RareLoot_124_Goodies.description: Pouch of dried meats, nuts, and other small edible miscellany resistant to spoilage. Popular with scavs and conscripts alike.

RareLoot_132_MCCMilitaryComputerPowerCel.description: Powerful military grade power cell of Europan origin.

RareLoot_135_RechargeableBattery.description: Popular with scavs for their utility and longevity.

RareLoot_136_CarBattery.description: Civilian grade power source from a vehicle.

RareLoot_137_SolarBattery.description: Solar batteries see limited use in a smog-choked world. As a renewable source of power, they nonetheless remain valuable. Manufactured by XAVAX.

RareLoot_139_MilitaryBattery.description: Military grade battery used to power Exos and smaller mech platforms.

RareLoot_14_HDD.description: 660 terabyte hard drive with neura-link capabilities and onboard AI. Manufactured by XAVAX.

RareLoot_140_GasmaskFilter.description: Old military gas mask and symbol of Euruskan heritage.

RareLoot_25_OLED.description: Flexible OLED screen. Manufactured by Hypax Group.

RareLoot_27_Wires.description: Bundle of assorted wires. Useful for crafting.

RareLoot_29_OutletPort.description: Biomechanical outlet of Euruskan origin. Used to interface with wetware devices.

RareLoot_30_Relay.description: Electrically operated switch used for various devices.

RareLoot_31_ElectricMotor.description: An old device that generates mechanical energy. Useful for crafting.

RareLoot_32_Screws.description: A handful of screws. Useful for fastening things together.

RareLoot_33_Bolts.description: A handful of bolts. Useful for fastening things together.

RareLoot_34_Nuts.description: A handful of nuts. Useful for fastening things together.

RareLoot_35_Nails.description: A handful of ordinary nails. Useful for crafting.

RareLoot_37_BoltCutters.description: A set of old bolt-cutters. The scav's master key.

RareLoot_38_PrecisionBoltCutters.description: Heavy-duty bolt cutter with a durable boron-carbide jaw. Manufactured by Zaikatsu.

RareLoot_40_HandDrill.description: An old drill operated using a hand crack. Better than nothing.

RareLoot_41_Hammer.description: An ordinary hammer. A common and indispensable tool.

RareLoot_43_Wrench.description: A large and hefty pipe wrench. A useful plumbing tool.

RareLoot_44_BasicPliers.description: A basic hand tool used for gripping, cutting, and bending various materials.

RareLoot_45_AdvancedPliers.description: A premium set of pliers in excellent condition.

RareLoot_46_Sledgehammer.description: A large and heavy sledgehammer, useful for delivering massive blunt force.

RareLoot_47_SentientDrill.description: Fully autonomous drill, powered by a sophisticated organoid intelligence. Euruskan Machine Liturgy teaches that the suffering of the apparatus is holy.

RareLoot_48_MastertoldSet.description: Civilian grade tool set loaded with useful implements and materials.

RareLoot_49_NormalToolset.description: Ancient toolset from before the war. Resourceful hands can still find a use for them.

RareLoot_50_Ratchet.description: Rotary tool useful for automotive and mechanical repairs.

RareLoot_52_Crowbar.description: Durable metal tool used to pry, lift, and break.

RareLoot_53_Punch.description: Old tool used for creating precise holes in leather objects.

RareLoot_54_SewingKit.description: Ordinary sewing kit. Popular with scavs who must make the most of the few garments they have.

RareLoot_55_Multitool.description: Premium multi-tool featuring a high-frequency blade and micro-laser. Nanofabricated in Earth's low orbit.

RareLoot_57_CarbonFiberTube.description: Strong and light carbon fiber tubes. Useful for advanced crafting.

RareLoot_58_RibbedTube.description: Dirty ribbed tubing. Could be used for improvised crafts.

RareLoot_78_Plugcord.description: Tri-pin wetware plug of Euruskan origin.

RareLoot_95_Pressuregauge.description: Measures the pressure of fluids and gas.

RareLoot_96_VentilationRegulator.description: High-tech device that maintains efficient and reliable airflow.

RareLoot_99_CameraLens.description: Optical tool that beholds what you point it at.

RareMetals.description: Precious metals stripped from the remnants of a vehicle.

RFL01A_Surplus.description: Surplus rifle. Uses 5.45mm. One of 2 default starting weapons in the game. Scavs best friend.

RFL01B.description: Rifle variant. Uses 7.62mm. Best Budget Allround Rifle due to its good base Dmg and low Price.

RFL05.description: Rifle design now manufactured in Eurasian territories

RFL20.description: The SVD is a weapon in the rifles category. It has a magazine of 10, uses 54R ammunition and deals 300 damage. It can be bought from Aramaki.

RIG_EQUIPMENT_20mmTurret.description: Deploy a 20mm Turret, Single use, unrecoverable.

RIG_EQUIPMENT_ExoLegs.description: Reduces cost of stamina activities, such as sprinting, jumping, or vaulting. Does not affect stamina recover period or jump height. Provides a visual effect: 4 mechanical legs assist the player when running.

RIG_EQUIPMENT_SuperJump.description: Allows the scav to jump 2-3 times higher. Unlimited uses, can help to get to high places and opens up more routes and hiding spots on every map. Currently the best way to survive against the Euruskan Grabber

RIG_EQUIPMENT_TacCam.description: Scan for foes, allies, and valuable items.

Shanti_LootObject_01.description: A scav's former belongings. Now yours.

SHG02_Surplus.description: Surplus shotgun. Uses 12-gauge. One of 2 starting weapons in the game. With unusually high damage, it can oneshot Cyborgs and even destroy a tank in 13 shots, provided you're shooting point blank and all pellets hit.

SignalScrambler.description: An old, yet powerful signal broadcaster.

SMG01.description: Submachine gun. Uses .45ACP The initial barrel is integrally suppressed.

Stim.description: Stamina restored / drain reduced for 10s. Effectively gives infinite stamina for its duration.

T90_Debirs_Loot.description: Parts of a T-90 tank's suspension systems.
